results.title: Lions Tigers & Bears Sanctuary Faces Thousands in Storm Damage After Torrential Rains
results.description: The Lions Tigers & Bears animal sanctuary in Alpine is grappling with extensive cleanup and potential tens of thousands of dollars in repairs after a series of severe weather events including heavy rain and high winds. Staff are working tirelessly to restore damaged buildings, remove fallen trees, and repair fencing while ensuring the safety and care of the animals. Founder Bobbi Brink reports that floodwaters damaged interior spaces and flooring, with ongoing efforts focused on drying out areas and replacing destroyed materials. The financial toll is significant, with tractor work alone costing around $2,500 per day, as the sanctuary transitions from dealing with floodwaters to managing dry, windy conditions.

results.title: Duncan Brune has 2 rushing touchdowns, Ohio beats Sacramento State 48-7
results.description: Duncan Brune had two rushing touchdowns, Irving Brown had 87 yards rushing and a TD on eight carries, and Ohio beat Sacramento State 48-7. Ohio (5-2, 3-0 Mid-American Conference) has won four straight. Nick Poulos hit Preston Bowman for a 67-yard catch-and-run for a touchdown about 2 minutes into the third quarter that made it 34-0. Victor Rosa and Levi Davis each added a rushing TD for the Bobcats. Brian Salazar Jr. threw a 38-yard touchdown pass to Kenyon Shabazz about 2 1/2 minutes into the fourth quarter for Sacramento State. The Hornets (1-6, 0-4) have lost five in a row.
